title: Kenyan Meat Skewers
description: A classic Kenyan dish featuring marinated meat skewers grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Jelly (for glaze)
ingredients.notes: such as apricot or orange marmalade

ingredients.name: Meat skewers (bamboo or metal)
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together like, meat cubes, and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
3. Thread meat cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
4. Brush skewers with remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Brush with jelly glaze during last 2 minutes of grilling.
7. Serve hot with your choice of sides.
